verses.en: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.pt: O Senhor reina; está vestido de majestade. O Senhor se revestiu, cingiu-se de fortaleza; o mundo também está estabelecido, de modo que não pode ser abalado.
verses.en_web: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is King; he is clothed with glory; the Lord is clothed with strength; power is the cord of his robe; the world is fixed, so that it may not be moved.

verses.en: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
verses.pt: O teu trono está firme desde a antigüidade; desde a eternidade tu existes.
verses.en_web: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
verses.en_bbe: The seat of your power has been from the past; you are eternal.

verses.en: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.pt: Os rios levantaram, ó Senhor, os rios levantaram o seu ruído, os rios levantam o seu fragor.
verses.en_web: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
verses.en_bbe: The rivers send up, O Lord, the rivers send up their voices; they send them up with a loud cry.

verses.en: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.pt: Mais que o ruído das grandes águas, mais que as vagas estrondosas do mar, poderoso é o Senhor nas alturas.
verses.en_web: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord in heaven is stronger than the noise of great waters, yes, he is stronger than the great waves of the sea.

verses.en: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
verses.pt: Mui fiéis são os teus testemunhos; a santidade convém à tua casa, Senhor, para sempre.
verses.en_web: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
verses.en_bbe: Your witness is most certain; it is right for your house to be holy, O Lord, for ever.
